specimens.name: Precision folded chassis corner with captive threaded inserts
specimens.notes: Two captive threaded inserts are integrated into one precision folded chassis corner; no loose hardware or complete enclosure.

specimens.name: Flush countersunk aluminium lap joint
specimens.notes: Two short aluminium panel fragments form one precise lap joint with an even row of embedded screw heads; no separate fastener specimen.

specimens.name: Reinforced captive-thread mounting point
specimens.notes: Single locally reinforced sheet-metal mounting point with one captive threaded insert is clearly isolated.

specimens.name: Precision interlocking tab-and-slot chassis seam
specimens.notes: Two short sheet-metal fragments visibly interlock through repeatable tab/slot geometry; no complete box or rack.

specimens.name: Removable rack-ear-to-chassis joint
specimens.notes: Local rack-ear fragment, slotted mounting geometry and embedded service hardware remain an atomic joint rather than a rack assembly.

specimens.name: Captive quarter-turn service-panel flange joint
specimens.notes: Exactly two captive quarter-turn fasteners connect a local service flange and panel-edge fragment; not a complete hatch.

specimens.name: Replaceable precision reinforcement doubler
specimens.notes: Replaceable doubler shows two locator slots and an even embedded fastening pattern without crude repair language.

specimens.name: Rack-rail structural corner node with captive nut strip
specimens.notes: Short perforated rack rail, transverse member and compact corner node read as one local rack-specific structural node only.

review_method: Exact untouched PNG visually inspected against the merged E2 machine spec and style/era contracts; dimensions, byte count and SHA-256 verified locally, Drive archive readback preserved exact byte count, and the accepted source was moved from the rejected holding folder into the canonical E2_1998 archive folder.
